app.name: Modubex

signIn.title: Sign in

signUp.subtitle: Set up your identity to access Modubex.

forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we will send a reset link.

verify.success: Your email address has been verified.
verify.intro: Enter your email to request a new verification link.
verify.tokenBody: Use the button below to confirm the address linked to your account.

twoFactor.challengeSubtitle: Enter the code from your authenticator app.

twoFactor.invalidCode: That code is not valid. Try again.
twoFactor.saveCodes: Store these codes somewhere safe; each one can be used once.
twoFactor.disableSubtitle: Disable two-factor authentication with your password before setting it up again.

invitation.title: Accept an invitation
invitation.subtitle: Confirm the invitation to join this workspace.
invitation.success: Invitation accepted. You can continue to the workspace.
invitation.createSubtitle: Create an invitation link for someone to join this workspace.
invitation.invalidToken: This invitation link is invalid or has expired.

errors.invalidCredentials: The email or password is incorrect.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait before trying again.

overview.title: The foundation is in place.
overview.subtitle: The foundation and identity layers are in place. Each check below reads real project state.
overview.readinessHint: Derived from files and configuration in this checkout.
overview.summarySubtitle: Live workspace state from settings and the entitlement seam.

rbac.title: Roles and permissions
rbac.subtitle: System roles are locked. Custom roles combine permissions from the catalog.

rbac.permissionsSubtitle: Permissions registered in this workspace, grouped by resource and action. These checkboxes are read-only.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Manage members, role assignments, and active sessions.

detail.rolesHint: Roles determine what this member can access.
detail.lastOwnerWarning: The last Owner cannot be removed or demoted.
detail.deactivateHint: Deactivated members cannot sign in until reactivated.
detail.reactivateHint: Reactivate this account to allow sign-in again.

roles.title: Custom roles
roles.noSystem: No system roles have been seeded.
roles.deleteConfirmLabel: I understand this role will be permanently deleted.
roles.invalidInput: Check the key, name, and selected permissions before continuing.

audit.title: Audit logs
audit.subtitle: Filter security and admin events, export them, or run a retention purge.
audit.empty: No audit entries match these filters.
audit.purgeHint: Deletes entries older than the retention window and writes its own audit entry.
audit.purgeDisabledHint: Purge is unavailable while retention is set to keep logs forever.
audit.purgeConfirmLabel: I understand this permanently deletes old audit entries.

forbidden.title: Access denied
forbidden.body: You do not have permission to view this page. Ask an administrator if you believe this is a mistake.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Runtime settings are validated and applied immediately. Environment-only values are read-only.
settings.readOnly: You can view settings but do not have permission to change them.

performance.cacheReadsDescription: When disabled, reads go directly to Prisma.

security.requireTwoFactorDescription: Members without 2FA will be redirected to enrollment.

site.title: Site identity
site.subtitle: Branding shown across the app shell and metadata.

seo.title: SEO metadata
seo.subtitle: Defaults used when a page does not set its own metadata.

performance.title: Performance
performance.subtitle: Control how settings and entitlements are read.
performance.explanation: Runtime settings use the {tag} cache tag and a {seconds}-second revalidate window. A settings change expires the tag immediately.
performance.advancedHint: Turning cached reads off bypasses the Next.js cache and queries Prisma directly for every settings and entitlement read.

localization.title: Localization
localization.defaultLocaleHint: This locale is the fallback when no valid NEXT_LOCALE cookie exists. A user-selected locale always wins.

security.title: Security policy
security.liveNote: Sign-up and password reset use these values on the next request: {min} to {max} characters, number {number}, symbol {symbol}, 2FA {twoFactor}.

audit.title: Audit retention
audit.hint: Set 0 to keep audit entries forever. The audit viewer and purge action use this value immediately.

workspace.title: Workspace preferences
workspace.hint: Use an IANA time zone name, for example UTC or Europe/Paris.

infrastructure.title: Infrastructure status
infrastructure.subtitle: These values come from the environment, not the runtime settings table. Change them in your deployment and restart the app.
infrastructure.noValues: Values are intentionally hidden here; only configuration status is shown.

modules.title: Module store
modules.subtitle: Discover bundled modules, manage their lifecycle, and configure enabled features.

confirm.title: Confirm permanent removal
confirm.body: Deleting module data cannot be undone.
confirm.mismatch: The confirmation does not match the module id.

modules.typedConfirmLabel: Type the module id to confirm
modules.lockedHint: Upgrade your plan to manage this module.
modules.dependentsBlocked: Other enabled modules depend on this module.
modules.noModules: No modules are bundled in this build.
modules.manageRequired: You can view modules but do not have permission to change them.
modules.settingsHint: Fields are generated from the module's validated settings schema.
modules.settingsReadOnly: You do not have permission to change module settings.

license.title: License and entitlements
license.subtitle: The plan mapping defines available features. Installed modules are managed separately.
license.restrictionBody: Advanced performance tuning requires Pro or Enterprise.
license.manageSubtitle: Update the workspace plan and optional license details.
